Require: Interestingness measure I(entity,graph) -> R.
Require: Knowledge Graph G = (V,E) with definitions D C V.
Require:Number of definitions to sample N ∈ N+. Require: Simulation limit Slim ∈ N+.
1: Dsampled ←@ Set of N sampled definitions
2: Scores←0
Map each definition to its interestingness score
3:for each definition d ∈ D do
4:Scores[d] ← I(d,G)
5: end for 6:
7:Dsampled ← SampleByScore(Scores, N) Apotential ← EnumeratePossibleActions(Dsampled, G)
8: Asim ← Sample(Apotential, min(Slim,|Apotentiatl)) > Randomly sample up to Slim actions
for simulation
9:SimulatedActionScores ←{
10:for each action a ∈ Asim do
11:enew ← SimulateAction(a,G) Simulate action a to get resulting entity enew
12:scorea ←I(enew,G) Compute interestingness of the new entity
13:SimulatedActionScores[a] ← scorea
14: end for
15:a* ← SampleByScore(Asim,1)
